scripts.deploy:cli: npm run build:cli && npx wrangler kv key put --namespace-id 2328f53c6e5846d6830cae916254634c cli:bundle --path dist/skillport.js --remote && npx wrangler kv key put --namespace-id 2328f53c6e5846d6830cae916254634c cli:version "$(node -e "var p=require('./package.json').version,c=require('child_process');process.stdout.write(p+'-'+c.execSync('git rev-list HEAD --count',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()+'.'+c.execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim())")" --remote
